exact: negative regulation of thrombin receptor signaling pathway
related: negative regulation of thrombin receptor signalling pathway

definition: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of thrombin-activated receptor protein signaling pathway activity. A thrombin receptor signaling pathway is the series of molecular signals generated as a consequence of a thrombin-activated receptor binding to one of its physiological ligands.
label: negative regulation of thrombin-activated receptor signaling pathway
